title: Fortification of Bread Wheat Using Synthesized Zn-Glycine and Zn-Alanine Chelates in Comparison with ZnSO4 in a Calcareous Soil
authors: Mirbolook A, Lakzian A, Rasouli Sadaghiani M, Sepehr E, Hakimi M
journal: Communications in Soil Science and Plant Analysis
notes: Greenhouse experiment with 3 Zn sources (Zn-Gly, Zn-Ala, ZnSO4) x 3 application methods (soil, foliar, fertigation), n=3. Grain Zn concentration data is presented in Figure 4 as bar charts. No explicit no-Zn control treatment is included in the experimental design - all treatments received some form of Zn. The paper compares different Zn SOURCES and METHODS but does not include a zero-Zn control. Therefore no valid Zn vs no-Zn comparisons can be extracted.
